integrations.name: Facebook Messenger
integrations.description: Meta's messaging platform for Facebook Pages.

pairs.headline: Turn every Messenger conversation into a structured, de-duplicated lead row in Google Sheets.
pairs.intro_md: Facebook Messenger is where many leads first reach you, but Google Sheets is where your team actually works. With n8n in the middle, each new message can be verified, parsed for name, intent and contact details, and written to a sheet automatically, without anyone copying and pasting at the end of the day.
pairs.best_for: Small sales and support teams that take enquiries through a Facebook Page and still copy details into a spreadsheet by hand.

use_cases.title: Lead capture from ad clicks
use_cases.body: People who tap a click-to-Messenger ad start a conversation, not a form. The workflow records each new conversation as a row keyed by the sender's page-scoped ID, so repeat messages update the same lead instead of creating duplicates.

use_cases.title: AI intent tagging
use_cases.body: A language model reads the message and labels it as pricing, booking, support or complaint, and extracts a budget or phone number if one was written. Your team can then filter the sheet by intent rather than reading every thread.

use_cases.title: Hot-lead handoff
use_cases.body: A simple score built from intent, stated budget and contact completeness lets you flag the best leads. Rows above a threshold can trigger a team alert, so the people who respond first are looking at the enquiries most likely to convert.

use_cases.title: Support triage log
use_cases.body: Even if you never sell through Messenger, a running log of what customers ask is valuable. Writing each conversation's topic and language to a sheet gives you a lightweight dataset for spotting recurring questions and gaps in your documentation.

steps.name: Create a Meta app and add Messenger
steps.text: In the Meta developer dashboard, create an app, add the Messenger product, and connect the Facebook Page that receives your messages.

steps.name: Import the n8n workflow
steps.text: Import the FlowSaaS Messenger CRM JSON into n8n and open each node that shows a warning to attach credentials.

steps.name: Prepare the Google Sheet
steps.text: Create a sheet using the provided column template and connect your Google account to the Sheets nodes.

steps.name: Subscribe the webhook
steps.text: Copy the n8n production webhook URL into the Messenger webhook settings, use your verify token, and subscribe the Page to the messages field.

steps.name: Test, then activate
steps.text: Send a message to your Page, confirm a row appears, then switch the workflow to active.

pairs.limits_md: Replies sent through the Send API must fall inside Meta's 24-hour standard messaging window, and you are responsible for user consent.

faq.question: Do I need Meta App Review to use this?
faq.answer: You can test with people who have a role on your Meta app. To process messages from the general public, the pages_messaging permission requires App Review.

faq.question: Will the same person create duplicate rows?
faq.answer: No. The workflow looks up the sender's page-scoped ID first and updates the existing row if one is found.

faq.question: Can I use Airtable instead of Google Sheets?
faq.answer: Yes. The same pattern works with Airtable; see the Facebook Messenger to Airtable guide for the field mapping.
